text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Dammit~, I even used the secret door, so 
how did they find me...? 
I'm totally gonna get away!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—Halt. ...This is... I smell something. 
It reeks of danger, sir...!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“*Sniff*... *sniff*, that locker over 
there. 
It appears to be a trap. Let us bypass it 
and move forward.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—Hmph. ...I catch a scent. Where is it 
coming from... near the hollow of that 
large tree? 
Everyone, do not approach the hollow. It 
is a trap, sir.”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“H-How does she always know!? 
I even replanted grass over the trap so 
nobody would notice~~~!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—I smell it. 
Let us turn back and find another route.”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“~~~U-U-U-Uggghhhhhh!! 
You guys are no fun at alllll!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: “! Windy-senpai, could it be...—”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Fenomeno-senpai! 
I'm gonna take on the next trap head-on! 
So please don't tell me where it is!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“What!? W-What do you mean by that, 
Biko-san!?”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Windy-senpai's traps... are kind of like 
her way of crying out. 
She sets traps whenever she wants to play 
with someone or feels lonely.”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“So I have to properly respond to her 
feelings! 
Otherwise, even if we catch her, she won't 
tell us anything!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“I'll be the one to fall into the trap! 
Villains have their own reasons for doing 
bad things—and standing by them is what an 
ally of justice does!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Biko-san... 
Understood. I shall leave the next trap to 
you, sir.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff, sniff*... I smell it. There seems 
to be a trap nearby.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Alright, you guys hide over there in that 
safe spot. 
I'll go in alone!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Which way did Windy-senpai go? Over 
there, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“...Freeze, Biko. There's a trap just one 
step ahead of you. 
Not that it matters, since you guys have 
probably already seen through it anyway.”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: “Windy-senpai...? Huh, why—”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“None of you fell into my traps at all... 
so Windy-chan kind of lost her confidence. 
I'm throwing in the towel...”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Windy-san, you're willing to talk to us, 
then? 
In that case—”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: “Whoa! Cold!?”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Wahahaha, you let your guard down! That 
wasn't the only trap I set! 
I won't let you cheat by making Biko the 
only sacrifice!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Heh-heh! Windy-chan ain't gonna run or 
hide! 
If you wanna catch me, just try and make 
it over here~!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa, it's packed with traps! 
Looks like she's not even trying to hide 
them anymore.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“In that case... let us all charge at 
once, sir! 
It will be faster if we corner her from 
all four directions!!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“You're right! Alright, here we come, 
Windy-senpai!!”

text_block_list.name: Meno & Biko
text_block_list.text:
“Daaaaaaah! 
Haaaaaaah!”

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan, let's go too!

text_block_list.name: Big & Urara
text_block_list.text:
“Tooooryaaaaah! 
Yaaaaaaaah!”

text_block_list.name: All 4
text_block_list.text:
“‘Gwaaaah!!’ ‘Uwaaaah!!’ 
‘Kyaaaah!!’ ‘Howaaaah!?’”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Urrghh~~~... The world is spinning, 
sir... 
To think she buried a potter's wheel under 
our feet...”

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
“Not on my watch! 
Big-san won't be stopped by something like 
this...!”

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
“Teiyaaaaah! —Whoa-whoa-whoa! 
One more tiiiime! —Whoopsie-daisy!”

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
*Ptooey, ptooey*... As expected of 
Windy-chan, 
she really is the undisputed champion of 
the Tracen Prank Rankings!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
“However! Big-san will neeevvvveeer give 
up!! 
I'll definitely catch Windy-chan and 
achieve BIG results!”

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Trapped again! Wah-ha-ha, ha— 
...H-Huh...? W-When did you get over—!?”

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
“*Pant, pant*... Heheh, I finally made it 
this far...! 
—Are you ready? Windy-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...S-Stay back......... Uwaaaaaaaaah!!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Phew, thanks for the meal! That katsudon 
was super tasty! 
Interrogations aren't half bad~♪”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Windy-san found that door on her own. 
She only started sneaking in a few days 
ago, and had no knowledge of any other 
intruders.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The investigation is back to square 
one... No, by my own power alone, I have 
achieved nothing yet. The only reason 
we've gathered this much info is—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—Everyone, I have a request. 
Would you please lend me your cooperation 
in investigating the archives?”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Working alongside all of you made me 
realize something. 
To investigate the archives, I need your 
strength!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Urara-san's ‘innocent cheerfulness,’ 
which allowed her to befriend anyone and 
aid our questioning.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Biko-san's ‘true sense of justice,’ 
which considers even the feelings of an 
opponent.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Big-san's ‘never-give-up spirit,’ 
rising again and again no matter how many 
traps she fell into.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“And—Windy-san's flexible mindset born 
from ‘cunning schemes and villainous 
thinking’! 
A creative ingenuity entirely different 
from my own!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Having evaluated all of your capabilities, 
I sincerely request your assistance!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Evaluating *my* capabilities...! 
Of course! As an ally of justice, you can 
count on my help!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Me too! Ehehe, I'll do my best to help!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
This is a big chance to shine! Sounds 
good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You—you've got an eye for talent. 
Alright! Windy-chan, the baddest of the 
bad, will lend you a hand!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you so much! Well then, 
as the Archives Investigation Team—I look 
forward to working with you!
